title: Weyl algebras on Braverman-Kazhdan spaces
summary: Let $G$ be a split, simply connected, almost simple algebraic group over a field of characteristic zero, and let $P$ be a maximal parabolic subgroup of $G$. We study the ring of differential operators on $P^{\mathrm{der}}\backslash G$, showing that it shares several key structural properties with classical Weyl algebras. We also develop a corresponding theory of $D$-modules.
